title: Refresh cadence broken at 2026-10-24T05:36Z: deployed snapshot 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z is beyond its 8-hour stale bound after four consecutive scheduled publisher failures
detail: Observed first-hand 2026-10-24T05:31Z-05:55Z. The scheduled 'Refresh and deploy CS2 dashboard' workflow failed runs 40028653350, 40037957529, 40048429858 and 40063011446 after the last success 40015434337, all before collection, because tests/test_ca7e10e5_snapshot.py evaluates a fixed 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z fixture against the real clock and trips the production 12-hour refusal (locally reproduced: PublishRefused 'snapshot ... is 20.2h old (limit 12.0h)').
